messages.menu.presentation.title: Menu
messages.menu.presentation.lead: Create reusable navigation trees and deliver them through portable template keys or direct Mustache data.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.0.title: Create and edit
messages.menu.presentation.sections.0.steps.0: Select an existing menu or create one. Enter its name; the suggested stable ID/key can be adjusted before the first save. Renaming a saved menu never changes its key.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.0.steps.1: Use the left source panels to search published Pages and Blog posts, select several entries and add them together. Custom links, anchors and groups have their own panel; source choices are shown in pages of 25.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.0.steps.2: Expand an item to edit its label, destination, enabled/new-tab options or parent. Drag complete branches vertically to reorder and horizontally to nest, or use keyboard/touch icon controls. Up to five levels and 100 items are supported.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.1.title: Choose a delivery channel
messages.menu.presentation.sections.1.steps.0: Template key selects portable keys from installed manifests, without selecting or binding a template. Each key has its own presentation format.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.1.steps.1: Any template declaring the same typed Menu key can receive the menu, even when it maps that key to another physical location.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.1.steps.2: Mustache key exposes menu.ID-or-slug data without destination fields. Saved template keys remain inactive and preserved; template mode blocks direct ID/slug references.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.2.title: Compatibility and safe switching
messages.menu.presentation.sections.2.steps.0: Missing keys or unsupported format/depth produce an admin warning and unavailable public menu data. They do not prevent saving or produce a public compatibility error.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.2.steps.1: Unavailable keys remain editable for future templates. Claiming a key replaces its other active portable owner in the same revision-checked save; history preserves recovery.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.2.steps.2: Legacy per-template bindings are retained. Saving through this editor adopts portable keys; reads never migrate existing content.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.3.title: Render the public tree
messages.menu.presentation.sections.3.steps.0: The reference example is generated automatically from the stable menu key or selected template keys. Copy it into a receiving layout: menu.ID-or-slug.items in Mustache mode or template.key.items for declared positions. No manual binding registration is needed.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.3.steps.1: Items contain label, href, slug, anchor, newTab and children. Blog links store immutable post IDs and follow the current published slug. Draft, scheduled, disabled or removed sources do not become public. Use finite sections/inverted sections, safe links and layout-owned formatting.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.4.title: Overview and recovery
messages.menu.presentation.sections.4.steps.0: Search and clear filters with the icon controls. Column headers change ordering; the pager preserves filters and shows result/page totals.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.4.steps.1: Use Trash for recoverable removal and History to restore earlier catalogs. Concurrent changes are rejected without overwriting the saved catalog.
messages.menu.identityHelp: Stable key used by Mustache. Editing the name does not change it.
messages.menu.structureHelp: Drag items vertically to reorder and horizontally to nest. A parent moves with its children. Icon controls and parent selection provide the same operations. Maximum: five levels and 100 items.
messages.menu.structureEmpty: Select content on the left or add a new item to begin.
messages.menu.referenceHelp: Reference generated automatically from the menu key or selected template keys. Copy this example into the receiving layout; no manual binding is required. Repeat children sections for additional levels. The layout must handle empty group links and newTab/rel behavior.
messages.menu.copyFailed: Copy was unavailable. Select and copy the displayed example.
messages.menu.removeHelp: Choose what happens to its children. The change is applied only to this editor until saved.
messages.menu.removeBranch: Remove this item and all its descendants
messages.menu.promoteChildren: Remove only this item and promote its children
messages.menu.discardChanges: Discard unsaved changes and switch menus?
messages.menu.noSources: No published content matches this search.
messages.menu.error.limit: A menu accepts at most 100 items. No items were added.
messages.menu.error.post: The selected post is unavailable. Choose a published post.
messages.menu.presentation.sections.0.steps.3: Removing a parent opens a choice: delete the entire branch or promote its children. Cancel preserves every item. Save and reopen to confirm; the receiving layout controls appearance.
